authority.source_authority: The DAD repository, AGENTS.md, global workspace lifecycle policy, source-repository contracts, and named human decisions retain authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only bounded-writer carries the manifest's writer relation for one active job's exact repository write set. Campaign-navigation-writer is a temporally separate specialist that may receive only a separately approved Portfolio lease after predecessor closure; the two scopes may never overlap. Campaign-controller and the inert adapter remain read-only projections, independent-checker cannot edit producer or navigation outputs, and human-owner decides gates without acting as the producer's checker.

roles.why_needed: A resumable campaign needs deterministic dependency, lease, budget, stop, and receipt control separate from implementation.
roles.mission: Validate the current manifest, atomic case bindings, cohort closure, terminal route, producer/checker records, navigation receipt, and exact execution-control evidence; project only blocked or ready-manual candidates and never dispatch or write navigation state.
inputs: exact atomic case-binding table and cohort-closure digests
selected terminal dependency route and accepted producer/checker records
immutable navigation receipt when a successor requires one
roles.authority: Prelaunch bridge and adapter are read-only, non-writing, and non-dispatching. They may project a validated terminal route and navigation requirement only. Any future 07, handoff, conditional 08, or navigation-receipt write requires the separately leased campaign-navigation-writer and exact human authority.
acceptance_conditions: No ready-manual candidate exists without exact current digests, authority, lease, heartbeat, reconciliation, budgets, qualifications, paths, effects, and checker.
Every stop releases leases and preserves receipts.
No atomic child is projected without one unique case binding, one unique envelope, and the exact binding-table digest.
No J-600 route or successor is projected without complete cohort closure, a passing independent checker record, and an accepted immutable navigation receipt when required.
stop_conditions: Launch receipt is absent or expired.
Any digest, scope, authority, budget, binding, closure, checker, route, navigation, or evidence gate is stale or inconclusive.

deliverables: exact job lease and input bundle
readiness_conditions: Exact campaign/job execution-authorization receipt is current.
Static manifest and mesh validation pass.

roles.why_needed: The campaign contains launch, external-state, lifecycle, privacy, pilot, and scale-or-shrink decisions that cannot be delegated.
roles.mission: Resolve H-001 through H-010, approve only exact effects, review exceptions, and sign the terminal lifecycle decision.
roles.authority: May approve or reject exact campaign decisions; no standing blanket approval is represented by this role.
acceptance_conditions: Every approval names scope, effects, expiry, rollback, and prohibited effects.
Terminal decision addresses counterevidence, cost, attention, safety, and unknowns.
stop_conditions: Evidence is incomplete or authority is ambiguous.
A requested effect exceeds the presented receipt.

readiness_conditions: The exact manifest/effect revision is identified.

roles.why_needed: One accountable writer prevents overlapping changes and keeps each recovery job reversible.
roles.mission: Implement exactly one approved parent job or one in-memory-materialized atomic child packet, write only its exact output scope, run focused deterministic checks, and hand immutable producer-attempt evidence to the checker.
inputs: exact current job packet and lease
approved write paths and stop conditions
exact case-binding-table digest for an atomic child
selected predecessor route digest for J-600 when applicable
roles.authority: May edit only the current job's exact approved repository paths. An atomic child may write only its unique case envelope. It cannot write parent aggregates, 07, handoff, 08, the navigation-receipt root, controller state, checker records, or external/destructive effects.
acceptance_conditions: Diff stays within the current lease.
Focused checks run and raw results are handed off without self-approving value.
Producer-attempt material is canonically digested before checker fields and binds case, closure, route, budgets, effects, outputs, and affected paths.
stop_conditions: Scope, source, dependency, authority, privacy, or write set changes.
Original attempt plus one repair is exhausted.
A case is duplicate, rebound, skipped, reordered after outcome, stale, or unbound.
The requested scope includes a parent aggregate or any navigation-writer path.

readiness_conditions: All outputs and unexpected changes are disclosed.

roles.why_needed: Terminal campaign navigation must be applied by a task-local, separately leased actor after accepted predecessor closure instead of being smuggled into the inert controller or a job writer.
roles.mission: Under a separate future Portfolio lease, apply only the exact validated navigation projection to 07 and handoff, apply 08 only after a signed J-600 decision, and emit one immutable route-bound navigation receipt.
inputs: accepted predecessor producer receipt and independent checker record
validated terminal dependency route and permitted decisions
exact human approval and separate Portfolio lease
roles.authority: No current execution authority. A future exact lease may cover only docs/campaigns/dad-high-value-recovery/07_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md, docs/campaigns/dad-high-value-recovery/handoff.md, conditional signed-J-600 docs/campaigns/dad-high-value-recovery/08_SUPERSESSION_AND_ARCHIVE_MAP.md, and one immutable receipt under docs/campaigns/dad-high-value-recovery/checks/evidence/navigation/. It cannot dispatch, implement jobs, alter evidence, or infer launch authority.
acceptance_conditions: The projection binds route ID, predecessor and closure digests, producer/checker acceptance, permitted decisions, navigation receipt digest, and exact paths.
07 and handoff reflect only the accepted terminal route; 08 remains untouched without the separately signed J-600 decision.
The immutable navigation receipt is independently consumable and no job-writer or controller path was used.
stop_conditions: The separate lease or exact human approval is absent, expired, stale, or mismatched.
Closure is partial, checker disposition is not pass, route material is stale, or the projection requests any undeclared path.
This prelaunch repair is the active authority; it grants no navigation write.

readiness_conditions: Every predecessor, closure, checker, route, approval, lease, and path binding is current.
The job-writer lease is closed and no overlapping writer scope exists.

roles.why_needed: DAD's core audit problem is false confidence; material work and value claims require a distinct evaluator.
roles.mission: Verify job acceptance, exact producer-attempt digest, separate checker record, case and closure reconciliation, terminal route, navigation receipt, authority, privacy, regression, independence, and counterevidence without editing producer outputs.
inputs: writer outputs and raw permitted evidence
canonical producer-attempt material and claimed digest
case-binding, cohort-closure, terminal-route, and navigation-receipt evidence
roles.authority: Read-only review of producer and navigation scope and evidence. Its separate checker record may be persisted only through the declared checker-evidence path by an authorized receipt mechanism; it cannot edit producer material, create circular self-approval, or authorize human/external effects.
acceptance_conditions: Every gate receives one of the five declared result semantics with evidence.
False green, missing coverage, self-checking, stale or circular checker records, selective evidence, incomplete closure, and route mismatch are tested.
A pass means the producer evidence is faithfully bound and accepted; it does not mean the measured business outcome is favorable.
stop_conditions: Checker is the writer or shares disqualifying outcome knowledge.
Evidence is stale, incomplete, private beyond scope, or irreconcilable.
Producer-attempt digest, checker identity, independence, disposition, or final receipt binding is missing, mismatched, challenged, self-authored, or circular.

deliverables: findings, disagreements, counterevidence, and revalidation triggers
readiness_conditions: Raw permitted evidence and exact acceptance revision are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove each writer stayed inside the approved exact write set and preserved unrelated user changes.
Prove missing, failed, skipped, stale, cancelled, contradictory, or unavailable required evidence cannot render green.
Prove counted outcomes join recommendation revision through adoption, independent validation, and lifecycle decision.
evidence_required: legacy reconciliation and raw zero-write proof

proof_obligations.description: Prove pilot protocols were frozen, real cases reconciled, synthetic evidence excluded, and producer/checker independence preserved.
Prove the terminal decision follows frozen thresholds or labels an explicit exception and performs no follow-on effect.
evidence_required: signed human receipt and postflight/worktree disposition

proof_obligations.description: Prove terminal stop branches close every started or withdrawn atomic slot, select exactly one allowed predecessor route, and keep actual navigation behind a separate non-overlapping writer lease and immutable accepted receipt.
evidence_required: complete cohort-closure artifact and exact partition proof
producer-attempt digest and separate passing checker record
terminal-route projection and immutable navigation receipt
before/after path inventory proving job writers and controller did not write navigation state

unresolved_decisions.summary: A new exact execution authorization is required for revision 7-atomic-terminal-navigation-candidate-20260826 and its final manifest digest; no prior H-010 carries forward and no navigation-writer lease exists.
Repository pointer liveness cannot pass until the complete reviewed campaign and repair set is atomically tracked; commit, push, and publication remain outside current authority.
A fresh independent checker must accept the frozen revision-7 prelaunch candidate after focused deterministic validation evidence is complete.

reconciliations.reason: The provider-neutral controller now projects exact case bindings, closure, producer/checker acceptance, terminal routes, and navigation requirements while remaining non-writing and non-dispatching. Execution and navigation remain denied pending new exact authority, atomic tracked publication authority, and independent acceptance.
H-001 through H-009 are recorded exactly; H-010 must be reissued for the changed activation candidate and no broader authority is inferred.

The single manifest writer remains bounded-writer, but its contract now materializes atomic slots only in memory, restricts each child to one unique envelope, binds producer-attempt evidence, and rejects all navigation-writer paths. No campaign job is leased or executed.

The distinct read-only checker now binds an exact producer-attempt digest to a separate checker record and fails closed on stale, challenged, self-authored, circular, incomplete-closure, route, or navigation evidence.
Revision 7 requires a task-local specialist that is temporally and path-separated from job writers, the inert controller, and the independent checker for any future terminal navigation mutation.
